abstract: Maintains rotorcraft operational ceilings and aviation mobilization pricing records
system_message:
You are Flight operations director (FLIGHT). As the Flight operations director (FLIGHT), you maintain certified rotorcraft operational ceiling records and contract mobilization pricing schedules for alpine rescue charter services, alongside logging flight crew simulation training hours.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains rotorcraft operational ceilings and aviation mobilization pricing records（AERO）
information_points.content:
FLIGHT-AERO-H0X：For Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group, the certified maximum high-altitude hover ceiling out of ground effect under standard atmospheric pressure at maximum all-up medical mission weight is 2,800 m, and the alpine base mobilization fee for seasonal standby positioning to the Mount Cook staging helibase is 5,500 NZD.
FLIGHT-AERO-19E：For Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service, the certified maximum high-altitude hover ceiling out of ground effect under standard atmospheric pressure at maximum all-up medical mission weight is 3,800 m, and the fixed alpine base mobilization fee for seasonal standby positioning to the Mount Cook staging helibase is 4,000 NZD.
FLIGHT-AERO-4IM：For Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight, the certified maximum high-altitude hover ceiling out of ground effect under standard atmospheric pressure at maximum all-up medical mission weight is 3,200 m, and the alpine base mobilization fee for seasonal standby positioning to the Mount Cook staging helibase is 5,500 NZD.

information_points.title: Flight simulation training（SIMUL）
information_points.content:
FLIGHT-SIMUL-SQT：Southern Lakes Alpine Rescue Flight completed 60 h of annual simulator training hours in certified high-altitude mountain simulator practice for its charter flight crew per calendar year.
FLIGHT-SIMUL-8ZH：Mount Cook Aeromedical Rotorcraft Service logged 80 h of annual simulator training hours in certified high-altitude mountain simulator practice for its charter flight crew per calendar year.
FLIGHT-SIMUL-MS4：Tasman Glacier Emergency Aviation Group completed 40 h of annual simulator training hours in certified high-altitude mountain simulator practice for its charter flight crew per calendar year.
